title: Exoplanetology
description: Most stars have planets. Watch a star's light dip as one crosses in front of it, and the dip gives its size; its spectrum through the planet's air gives what it is made of. Unlocks transit photometry and the assay of exoplanet cores.

puzzle.goal: A planet of radius r crosses in front of its star, whose radius is R, and blocks part of its light. Write the fraction δ of the starlight that is lost, as a percentage.
puzzle.name: Transit depth
puzzle.ask: Find δ in per cent for a Jupiter-sized planet (r = 7.0e7 m) in front of the Sun (R = @{R} m).
puzzle.method: The planet's disc blocks an area πr² of the star's disc πR².
